88.fbtext:
«إذًا تُكفى همَّك» 🤍
"Then your worries will be taken care of…"

A hadith about sending salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ: Ubayy ibn Ka'b (may Allah be pleased with him) asked how much of his du'a he should give to salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ: a quarter, a half, two-thirds… then all of it. He ﷺ said: "Then your problems would be solved and your sins would be forgiven." (Jami' at-Tirmidhi 2457)

What helps you remember to send salawat upon the Prophet ﷺ through your day?
Follow Taqwa Lantern for daily reminders 🤍

🎙️ الشيخ بدر المشاري | Sheikh Badr Al-Mishari
Hadith: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 2457 (Ubayy ibn Ka'b), told in his words. Graded hasan by al-Tirmidhi, Ibn Hajar and al-Albani; some scholars graded its chain weak. The speaker names Abu Dharr; the narrator is Ubayy ibn Ka'b. "Your debt will be paid" is not in the narration. Translation: sunnah.com. English subtitles: Taqwa Lantern translation.

#الصلاة_على_النبي #salawat #hadith

"O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating partners with You while I know, and I ask Your forgiveness for what I do not know."

A du'a for the sins you know and the ones you never noticed: shirk can be more hidden than an ant creeping on a solid rock on a pitch-dark night, and this du'a the Prophet ﷺ taught covers both. Make it part of your daily wird.
